scguns.desc.atomic_carabine: A successor to the M3 Carabine, thrown together by the Rad Agents before they succumbed to the radiation.
scguns.desc.fission_fever: A quick firing submachine gun, however its amount of exposed uranium has raised safety concerns.
scguns.desc.genesis: The gun that was given the codename 'Genesis' by the research team, a powerful light machine gun that they used to defend themself from the Abomination.
scguns.desc.foul_emesis: A shotgun put together by the researchers, often had a bad smell... almost like vomit...
scguns.desc.corroder: A small pistol they kept around the lab, as it was quick to reload and enter battle with.
scguns.desc.acid_sprayer: A lightweight submachine gun often used for taking down any low-threat hostiles.
scguns.desc.halibut_cannon: A mysterious fish from the depths... Mutated perhaps...?
scguns.desc.sea_serpent: A sniper rifle with some fancy cogs! A great gun for hunting large fish, or perhaps.. other beasts...
scguns.desc.elver_tide: The juvenile eel, a lightweight submachine gun. Particularly useful for taking out schools of food.
scguns.desc.moray_tide: The mature eel, a strong lmg to defeat.... wait... what is that thing in the water...?
scguns.desc.mahi: The first gun put together by the Brine, a simple bolt-action pistol, shooting air-propelled needles. Careful not to poke yourself!
scguns.desc.neptunes_bounty: An early hunting weapon made by the brine. Being able to reuse the same spear was very helpful in a time when resources were scarce.
scguns.desc.ebony_ivory: Dual pistols they found left behind inside of an old house, shooting a very peculiar red energy. We are clueless as to what it is. But our research continues.
scguns.desc.dragonfly: A long-range rifle wielded by the gazer, the Asghar team has yet to figure out what these guns are made of.
scguns.desc.eclipse: Turns out the underzealots have style after all. This gun while held awkwardly, does has a very nice looking design. We got this name from the inscriptions on the body, possibly referencing an ancient event of some kind.
scguns.desc.redstone_repeater: An automatic rifle that was made in attempt to replicate forlorn weaponry, a failed attempt at that.
scguns.desc.sauron: Its origins or even what it is, is currently unknown. A mysterious creature in robes was spotted with a similar looking eye.
scguns.desc.guano_cannon: A cannon put together as simple self defense. Its ammo, guano, is very abundant in these caves. There is a particular obese bat that stole one of these... The team named him Jerry.
